# Catamaran Tours in Cancún

Private charters, shared adventures — on the most beautiful waters in Mexico.

## Catamaran Tours in Cancun

Explore the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea aboard our luxury catamarans. From intimate private charters to fun shared group tours — every experience is crafted to perfection.

All tours include **open bar**, **snorkeling equipment**, and the services of our expert bilingual crew. We depart from the Marina Playa Tortugas in the Hotel Zone.

### Tour Types

*   **Private Charter:** Exclusive use of the entire catamaran for your group. Perfect for weddings, birthdays, corporate events and romantic getaways.
*   **Shared Tour:** Join other guests for a fun social experience at a great price.

Not sure which tour is right for you? [Contact us](https://cancuncatamarans.mx/contacto) and our team will help you choose the perfect experience.
